message.content: The plan for a stable model has a latent space. The code sets a data path. Data goes past an encoder block and a decoder block. At each stage, data goes past a conv block, a norm block, and a pool block. A path takes the data to a later stage. The end maps a raw latent sample to a clean latent sample at a set step level.
